library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(MuMIn)
pacman::p_load(Stat2Data, tidyverse, plot3D, viridis)
ins_raw <- read.csv("insurance.csv")

ins <- ins_raw |>
  mutate(region_group = case_when(
    region %in% c("northeast", "southeast") ~ "East",
    region %in% c("northwest", "southwest") ~ "West",
    TRUE ~ "Other")) |>
      select(age, sex, bmi, children, smoker, charges, region_group)


table(ins$region_group)

East West 
 688  650 
ins <- na.omit(ins)
ins <- ins |>
  mutate(across(c(sex, smoker, region_group, children), as.factor))
head(ins)
  age    sex    bmi children smoker   charges region_group

2  18   male 33.770        1     no  1725.552         East
3  28   male 33.000        3     no  4449.462         East

5  32   male 28.880        0     no  3866.855         West
6  31 female 25.740        0     no  3756.622         East
str(ins)
'data.frame':   1338 obs. of  7 variables:
 $ age         : int  19 18 28 33 32 31 46 37 37 60 ...
 $ sex         : Factor w/ 2 levels "female","male": 1 2 2 2 2 1 1 1 2 1 ...
 $ bmi         : num  27.9 33.8 33 22.7 28.9 ...
 $ children    : Factor w/ 6 levels "0","1","2","3",..: 1 2 4 1 1 1 2 4 3 1 ...
 $ smoker      : Factor w/ 2 levels "no","yes": 2 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 ...
 $ charges     : num  16885 1726 4449 21984 3867 ...
 $ region_group: Factor w/ 2 levels "East","West": 2 1 1 2 2 1 1 2 1 2 ...
pairs(charges ~ age + factor(sex) + bmi + factor(children) + factor(smoker) + factor(region_group), data = ins)
pairs(charges ~ age + bmi, data = ins) &
pairs(log(charges) ~ I(age^2) + I(bmi^2), data = ins)
logical(0)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
boxplot(charges ~ smoker, data = ins, 
        ylab = "Charges", xlab = "Smoker (yes/no)", 
        main = "Charges by Smoker Status")
boxplot(charges ~ sex, data = ins, 
        ylab = "Charges", xlab = "Sex", 
        main = "Charges by Sex")
boxplot(charges ~ region_group, data = ins, 
        ylab = "Charges", xlab = "Region", 
        main = "Charges by Region")
boxplot(charges ~ children, data = ins,
        ylab = "Charges", xlab = "Children", 
        main = "Charges by Children")
#models
lm_full <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + sex + bmi + children + smoker + region_group, data = ins)

lm1 <- step(lm(log(charges) ~ age + bmi + smoker + bmi:smoker + children + sex + region_group, data = ins))

lm2 <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + I(age^2) + sex + bmi + I(bmi^2) + children + 
            smoker + region_group + age:sex + age:children + age:smoker + age:region_group + 
            sex:smoker + bmi:smoker + children:smoker + smoker:region_group, data = ins)

lm3 <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + I(age^2) + sex + bmi + children + 
            smoker + region_group + age:sex + age:children + age:smoker + age:region_group + 
            sex:smoker + bmi:region_group + bmi:smoker + children:smoker + 
            smoker:region_group, data = ins)

lm4 <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + I(age^2) + sex + bmi + I(bmi^2) + children +
            smoker + region_group + age:sex + age:bmi + age:children + age:smoker + age:region_group + sex:bmi + sex:children + sex:smoker + sex:region_group + bmi:children + bmi:region_group + bmi:smoker + children:region_group + children:smoker +smoker:region_group, data = ins) #Nicholas' model

lm5 <- lm(log(charges) ~ I(age^2) + factor(sex) + I(bmi^2) + factor(children) + factor(smoker) + factor(region_group), data = ins)

lm6 <- lm(log(charges) ~ I(age^2) + factor(sex) + I(bmi^2) + factor(children) + factor(smoker) + factor(region_group) + age:factor(sex) + age:bmi + age:factor(children) + age:factor(smoker) + factor(region_group) + factor(sex):bmi + factor(sex):factor(children) + factor(sex):factor(smoker) + factor(sex):factor(region_group) + bmi:factor(children) + bmi:factor(smoker) + bmi:factor(region_group) + factor(children):factor(smoker) + factor(children):factor(region_group) + factor(smoker):factor(region_group) , data = ins)

lm7 <- lm(log(charges) ~ I(age^2) +  (sex) + I(bmi^2) +  (children) +  (smoker) +  (region_group) + age: (sex) + age:bmi + age: (children) + age: (smoker) +  (region_group) +  (sex):bmi +  (sex): (children) +  (sex): (smoker) +  (sex): (region_group) + bmi: (children) + bmi: (smoker) + bmi: (region_group) +  (children): (smoker) +  (children): (region_group) +  (smoker): (region_group) , data = ins)
#factor doesn't matter

set.seed(999)
n <- nrow(ins)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, floor(0.7 * n))
train_data <- ins[train_idx, ]
test_data <- ins[-train_idx, ]

get_rmse <- function(model, test_df) {
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_df)
    is_log <- grepl("log", as.character(formula(model))[2])
  
  if (is_log) {
    preds <- exp(preds)
    actual <- test_df$charges
  } else {
    actual <- test_df$charges
  }
  
  return(sqrt(mean((actual - preds)^2)))
}

rmse_lm_full <- get_rmse(lm_full, test_data)
rmse_lm1     <- get_rmse(lm1, test_data)
rmse_lm2     <- get_rmse(lm2, test_data)
rmse_lm3     <- get_rmse(lm3, test_data)
rmse_lm4     <- get_rmse(lm4, test_data)
rmse_lm5     <- get_rmse(lm5, test_data)
rmse_lm6 <- get_rmse(lm6, test_data)

results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Full", "LM1", "LM2", "LM3", "LM4", "LM5", "LM6"),
  RMSE = c(rmse_lm_full, rmse_lm1, rmse_lm2, rmse_lm3, rmse_lm4, rmse_lm5, rmse_lm6)
)
print(results)
